description: This file contains tests for runtime configuration snapshot loading and pinning mechanism in an OpenClaw project. It defines test cases that verify the behavior of loading, reloading, and pinning snapshots of runtime configuration, using functions like loadConfig, getRuntimeConfigSourceSnapshot, and writeConfig. The tests involve file system operations to simulate config file changes in a temporary home directory.
